ev.q: this report describes trends in overdose deaths during January 2021–June 2024, overall and with IMFs detected
Overdose deaths with carfentanil detected increased approximately sevenfold, from 29 during January–June 2023 to 238 during January–June 2024
The percentage of deaths with IMFs detected was steady at approximately 70%–80% in the Northeast, Midwest, and South.
IMFs were detected in 81.5% of overdose deaths in the Northeast, 75.4% in the Midwest, and 74.9% in the South regions
Data on unintentional and undetermined intent drug overdose deaths obtained from death certificates

methods_quotes.q: Numbers of overdose deaths with carfentanil detected overall, and with carfentanil co-detected with illegally manufactured fentanyl
All trend analyses included 46 jurisdictions (45 states and DC).
For inclusion, jurisdictions were required to report ≥75% of deaths in their jurisdiction in each 6-month period during January 2021–December 2023.
Percentages with IMFs detected during this time frame are restricted to deaths with toxicology information entered
